title: Call Queued Event
description:
Event that is a result (basically a direct response) to the PlaceCallInstruction.
This one is generally used in the async versions of the calls.

call-id.description: The ID of the call this event belongs to.

instruction-id.description: The ID of the instruction the event is a result of.

caller.description: The id (e.g. number) of the caller.

callee.description: The id (e.g. number) of the callee.

success.description: True if the PlaceCallInstruction was accepted.

error.description: True if the PlaceCallInstruction was accepted.
